sum: Rainbow Investments Limited has filed a substantial acquisition disclosure under SEBI Regulation 31(4), indicating acquisition of shares in listed entity RPSG Ventures Limited. The disclosure is mandatory upon crossing prescribed shareholding thresholds under the Takeover Regulations.
detail: Rainbow Investments Limited has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011 with the NSE in respect of shares in RPSG Ventures Limited. Regulation 31(4) mandates disclosure of acquisition of shares representing 5% or more of voting capital or control rights. The filing confirms the transaction milestone but specific stake percentage, consideration, and offer timeline are to be extracted from the full disclosure document.
